name: fix-pos-table-merge-feedback
title: Fix false POS table merge errors and missing split refresh
description: Wire the POS table refresh callback correctly so merge/split update immediately and successful merges do not fall into the failure alert.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Fixed the actual callback-name mismatch: PosContext exposes refetchTables while LeftPanel requested refreshTables. LeftPanel now aliases refetchTables to its existing local name, so drag-drop merge refreshes without entering the false failure alert and TableActionsModal receives a valid refresh callback for merge/split. Added component regression coverage for both paths. Targeted Vitest and frontend build were not run because the connected environment has no repository checkout or installed project dependencies. No GitHub CI status was attached to the final commit.
